definitions.critical_false_negative: Expected STRONG_APPLY or APPLY predicted as LOW_PRIORITY or SKIP
definitions.expired_job_leakage: A record explicitly closed/expired at collection time predicted into surfaced output

decision_rule: Every gate must pass. A failure rejects E0.4.2 for promotion; this blind set becomes burned development evidence and must not be reused as promotion validation for a modified candidate.
holdout_policy: The sealed holdout remains unopened until this fresh blind production gate passes.
